what: When the last section, like the footer, enters, its inner content descends from −100% above and is revealed as if emerging from under the previous section — over a scroll distance equal to the section height

options.from: Distance at which it starts coming down (px, negative), default is its own height (−100%) — e.g. −1600 in one variant
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom — Brand ”top-=1200 100%」(from 1200px before the section touches the screen)
options.end: ScrollTrigger end, default section height (+=height) — Brand ”100% 100%”
options.scrub: Follow delay in seconds, default true (immediate) — Brand .1
options.pct: Where it starts coming down (% of its own height), default −100 — Brand −25. If from (px) is given, that takes priority
options.dim: [data-fx-part=dim] Opacity at which the cover starts to lift, default .5 — not used if there is no cover
options.[data-fx-part=dim]: Dark overlay on the inner top (optional) — the user sets position:absolute; inset:0; background: var(--kf-contrast-bg); Set to opacity:0

use:
Footer Content
— if there is no .fx-in, the first child
